description: This file contains functions related to managing requirements within the TestLink project, including importing/exporting requirement data, conflict resolution during import, requirement comparison, and link replacement in requirement descriptions.

methods.name: exportReqDataToXML
methods.description: Serializes requirement data into XML format for export.

methods.name: executeImportedReqs
methods.description: Processes requirements imported from CSV or other formats, handling conflict resolution and creation/updating of requirements.

methods.name: compareImportedReqs
methods.description: Compares imported requirements against existing ones to identify conflicts or duplicates.

methods.name: getReqDocIDs
methods.description: Retrieves document IDs of requirements associated with a specific requirement specification.

methods.name: loadImportedReq
methods.description: Loads and parses requirement data from a specified file based on import type.

methods.name: importReqDataFromCSV
methods.description: Reads requirement data from a CSV file and processes it into internal data structures.

methods.name: importReqDataFromCSVDoors
methods.description: Reads requirement data from a CSV file formatted for object-based requirements (Doors), converting it into internal data structures.

methods.name: importReqDataFromDocBook
methods.description: Parses requirements from a DocBook XML file, extracting requirements with associated descriptions and IDs.

methods.name: doReqImport
methods.description: Coordinates the import process, loading data, mapping existing requirements, and executing or comparing import data.

methods.name: exportReqDataToCSV
methods.description: Exports requirement data into CSV format with selected fields.

methods.name: getReqCoverage
methods.description: Computes coverage metrics for requirements in relation to test cases, including status and execution info.

methods.name: getLastExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves the last execution results for a set of test cases within a test plan.

methods.name: check_syntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of an import file based on its type (CSV, XML, etc.).

methods.name: check_syntax_xml
methods.description: Checks the syntax of an XML file for requirement import without detailed validation.

methods.name: check_syntax_csv
methods.description: Checks the syntax of a CSV file for requirement import without detailed validation.

methods.name: check_syntax_csv_doors
methods.description: Checks the syntax of a CSV file formatted for Doors requirements during import.

methods.name: req_link_replace
methods.description: Replaces BBCode-style links in requirement or requirement specification descriptions with actual hyperlinks.
